title: Sloth dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- dance floor hint: soft glowing oval -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a3b6b'/>
    <!-- music notes floating -->
    <g fill='#ffdd55'>
      <circle cx='18' cy='24' r='3'/>
      <rect x='20' y='10' width='2' height='15'/>
      <path d='M22 10 q6 1 6 6' stroke='#ffdd55' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
      <circle cx='82' cy='18' r='3'/>
      <rect x='84' y='5' width='2' height='14'/>
      <path d='M86 5 q6 1 6 6' stroke='#ffdd55' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
    </g>
    <!-- arms up, dancing -->
    <!-- left arm -->
    <g fill='#8a6a45' stroke='#a98457' stroke-width='2'>
      <path d='M30 45 Q15 35 12 22' stroke='#8a6a45' stroke-width='8' fill='none'/>
      <circle cx='11' cy='20' r='5'/>
    </g>
    <!-- right arm -->
    <g fill='#8a6a45' stroke='#a98457' stroke-width='2'>
      <path d='M70 45 Q85 33 90 20' stroke='#8a6a45' stroke-width='8' fill='none'/>
      <circle cx='91' cy='18' r='5'/>
    </g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#9a7a52'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='14' ry='14' fill='#c8a878'/>
    <!-- legs dancing -->
    <g stroke='#8a6a45' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <path d='M42 78 Q36 88 30 90'/>
      <path d='M58 78 Q66 86 72 84'/>
    </g>
    <circle cx='28' cy='90' r='5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='5' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='17' fill='#a98a5e'/>
    <!-- face mask lighter -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e8d0a8'/>
    <!-- eye patches dark brown -->
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='28' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#5a3f28'/>
    <ellipse cx='57' cy='28' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#5a3f28'/>
    <!-- eyes happy -->
    <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='2' fill='#fff3c4'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='2' fill='#fff3c4'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#c8a878'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#4a3020'/>
    <!-- smiling mouth -->
    <path d='M46 38 Q50 42 54 38' stroke='#4a3020' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='35' cy='20' r='4' fill='#8a6a45'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='20' r='4' fill='#8a6a45'/>
  </g>
</svg>
